name: dopadone-plugin
description: Source for the dopadone Claude Code plugin (health-rhythm interrupt + the /do skill). The shipped hooks are the esbuild-bundled CJS in bin/ (committed); end users never run install. The hooks import the domain math (phase/probability/agenda) from @dopadone/core/habits (#283), bundled in via the build alias; build:smoke proves that seam stays calendar-/node-free. The build/test alias path assumes a sibling checkout of the private dopadone repo at ../../../dopadone (dev-only — outsiders run the committed bins).
